items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And the things you can study now in arranging with Bob Brookmeyer’s music and Thad Jones

ctx.x: Yeah. And the things you can study now in arranging with Bob Brookmeyer’s music and Thad Jones, and that again is the other thing where it’s all, those guys just invented what they did. And for me I just go to a book and go oh, here’s Thad Jones’ voicing on the G7 chord. Okay, I’ll steal that. So I don’t have to think as hard as they did. I can just steal things from the books.

Isn’t that interesting how the amount of information available — is there some kind of ratio to innovation I guess. It almost doesn’t make it easier because there’s so much there. I can’t even finish my thought but I guess I almost long for some of the old days when things just seemed to be more spontaneous or from the heart.
